Hola Amigos & Welcome to Papi’s Tacos

Bienvenidos to Papi's Tacos, your vibrant slice of Mexico right here in the heart of Singapore! Prepare your taste buds for an authentic culinary fiesta, where every bite transports you to the bustling streets of Mexico. At Papi's, we're passionate about crafting traditional Mexican tacos with the freshest ingredients, delivering an explosion of flavors that will have you saying "¡Olé!" with every mouthwatering morsel.

Papi’s Tacos is Singapore’s best Mexican Restaurant. Open all day for walk-ins and available for catering + private events. Whether it’s for lunch, dinner, happy hour, a midday margarita, or late night taco, Papi has a seat for you!
